title: Basie personnel when Edison came to New York
summary: Edison lists trumpeters Bobby Moore and Taddy Smith, Claude Williams, Eddie Durham and Buster Smith.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No, no. That was before. I joined the band in New York. Well, Lips and all of them went in the band in the Grand Terrace. But I -- when we went to New York, Lips got -- you know, he got something going of his own so he left the band. And that's when they got Bobby Moore and then they had another trumpet player named Tad Jones. Tad, Tad Smith --
Tad Smith, I mean. Taddy Smith?
Taddy Smith. And Clarence Williamson, fiddler. He was --
Yeah, I just saw him in Europe.
Yeah, he played guitar and played fiddle, played both. And, let's see, who else was in there? Eddie Durham was in the band when we came to New York. And Buster Smith.
Buster Smith. Oh, yeah, I'd forgotten he was in there. That's before Earl Warren.
